title: Epigenetic silencing of SPHK1-IRF7 axis drives inflammaging in age-related meniscus degeneration via sphingolipid-immune dysregulation.
authors: Yang, Shunjie; Wang, Hui; Wang, Lingcheng; Liu, Li; Xu, Peng; Tian, Xiaohe; Chen, Gang
journal: Journal of orthopaedic surgery and research
one_liner_zh: 该文通过RNA测序和机器学习筛选衰老半月板损伤中的炎症相关生物标志物，虽涉及转录因子调控网络分析，但核心是临床诊断与免疫机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Age-related meniscus injury (MI) involves inflammaging, but biomarkers and mechanisms remain unclear. METHODS: Ribonucleic acid (RNA) sequencing of meniscal tissues from 15 young (< 45 years) and 15 aging (>/= 45 years) MI patients (training dataset) identified differentially expressed inflammation-related genes (DE-IRGs). Biomarkers were screened via least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) and support vector machines-recursive feature elimination (SVM-RFE) in the training dataset and validated through GSE191157 (testing dataset) and immunohistochemistry (IHC) staining in additional clinical specimens. Support vector machines (SVM) model and artificial neural network (ANN) model were constructed to predict the diagnostic performance of biomarkers for aging MI. Moreover, biomarkers enrichment analysis, and correlation among biomarkers, function-related genes, immune factors and immune cells were completed. Finally, transcription factor (TF)-biomarker-microRNAs (miRNAs) and competing endogenous RNA (ceRNA) regulatory networks analysis, and drug prediction were performed. RESULTS: IRF7 and SPHK1 were significantly downregulated in aging MI and predicted aging MI with high accuracy (area under the curve (AUC) > 0.7). Both biomarkers correlated with chemokine/cytokine pathways, immune senescence (positively with gammadeltaT cells/Th17/monocytes; negatively with LAG3/IL6R/TNFSF13), and sphingolipid metabolism (PLPP2 synergy) (|r| = 0.49 ~ 0.86, p < 0.05). Regulatory networks implicated NORAD lncRNA (upregulated) negatively regulated the expression of SPHK1 and IRF7 (r<-0.90, p < 0.05), while transcription factors E2F4 and KLF5 (downregulated) positively regulated their expression (r > 0.95, p < 0.05). Clinically, SPHK1 and IRF7 positively correlated with preoperative Lysholm score (SPHK1: r = 0.66; IRF7: r = 0.61; p < 0.05) and negatively with preoperative VAS (SPHK1: r=-0.58; IRF7: r=-0.58; p < 0.05) in aging MI. Two drugs (decitabine, acetaminophen) targeting these biomarkers were predicted. CONCLUSION: SPHK1 and IRF7 drive inflammaging via sphingolipid-immune crosstalk and epigenetic silencing, offering diagnostic and therapeutic potential.
abstract_zh: 背景：年龄相关性半月板损伤（MI）涉及炎症老化（inflammaging），但生物标志物及机制仍不明确。方法：对15例年轻（<45岁）和15例老化（≥45岁）MI患者的半月板组织进行核糖核酸（RNA）测序（训练数据集），鉴定差异表达的炎症相关基因（DE-IRGs）。通过最小绝对收缩和选择算子（LASSO）及支持向量机-递归特征消除（SVM-RFE）在训练数据集中筛选生物标志物，并通过GSE191157（测试数据集）及额外临床标本的免疫组织化学（IHC）染色进行验证。构建支持向量机（SVM）模型和人工神经网络（ANN）模型以预测生物标志物对老化MI的诊断性能。此外，完成生物标志物富集分析，以及生物标志物与功能相关基因、免疫因子和免疫细胞之间的相关性分析。最后，进行转录因子（TF）-生物标志物-微小RNA（miRNAs）及竞争性内源RNA（ceRNA）调控网络分析和药物预测。结果：IRF7和SPHK1在老化MI中显著下调，并以高准确性预测老化MI（曲线下面积（AUC）>0.7）。两种生物标志物与趋化因子/细胞因子通路、免疫衰老（与γδT细胞/Th17/单核细胞正相关；与LAG3/IL6R/TNFSF13负相关）及鞘脂代谢（PLPP2协同作用）相关（|r|=0.49~0.86，p<0.05）。调控网络提示NORAD长链非编码RNA（上调）负向调控SPHK1和IRF7的表达（r<-0.90，p<0.05），而转录因子E2F4和KLF5（下调）正向调控其表达（r>0.95，p<0.05）。临床上，SPHK1和IRF7与老化MI患者术前Lysholm评分正相关（SPHK1：r=0.66；IRF7：r=0.61；p<0.05），与术前VAS负相关（SPHK1：r=-0.58；IRF7：r=-0.58；p<0.05）。预测了两种靶向这些生物标志物的药物（地西他滨、对乙酰氨基酚）。结论：SPHK1和IRF7通过鞘脂-免疫串扰及表观遗传沉默驱动炎症老化，提供诊断和治疗潜力。
